reviewers.summary: The implementation adds the portfolio and read-only summary views, but several acceptance criteria lack tests that exercise the App host or their specified negative cases. The current tests would not catch incorrect row navigation, role-mismatched decision panels, executive worklist exposure, or sensitive extra projection fields appearing in the table.

findingList.message: The acceptance criterion for `executive_portfolio_row_opens_matching_read_only_summary` has no App-host test in this change.

evidence.codePathTraced: The portfolio table test in ExecutivePortfolio.test.tsx checks a component callback, but no App test selects a row and verifies the resulting route and summary.
evidence.failureScenario: If App routes case-002 to case-001 or fails to render its summary, the component callback test still passes.

findingList.message: The App-host role-matched decision-panel behavior required by the read-only acceptance criterion is not tested.

evidence.codePathTraced: `AC_017_executive_read_only_contract` tests ExecutiveCaseSummary in isolation. The App test added here checks portfolio navigation, but does not cover `executive_case_read_only_and_role_matched_decision_panels`.
evidence.failureScenario: If App renders a finance or technical decision panel for an executive or the wrong role, the standalone summary test still passes.

findingList.message: The `role route navigation` test does not cover the executive `/work` behavior required by the acceptance criterion.

evidence.codePathTraced: `role route navigation` signs in as an executive and checks `/portfolio`; it does not navigate to `/work` or assert the denial message and absence of worklist data.
evidence.failureScenario: If executive `/work` displays worklist data or omits `This page is not part of your workspace`, this test still passes.

findingList.message: The table contract test does not verify that sensitive values in extra projection properties are omitted.

evidence.codePathTraced: `executive_portfolio_table_contract` supplies only the listed display fields and asserts expected row text. It does not supply or check extra projection properties containing the forbidden sensitive values.
evidence.failureScenario: If the table starts rendering `SECRET-ITEM-1`, `SECRET-EVIDENCE`, `SECRET-DRAFT`, or `SECRET-DECISION` from extra projection properties, this test still passes.

reviewers.summary: The diff adds portfolio and read-only component tests plus executive Hangar assertions. Several required App-host behaviors and specified negative cases remain untested.

findingList.message: The AC_016 test does not verify the criterion that `/portfolio` loads `GET /api/v1/workspace/portfolio` through the App host.

evidence.codePathTraced: `AC_016_portfolio_kpis_contract` renders `ExecutivePortfolio` directly with supplied rows; it does not render the App or observe a request to `/api/v1/workspace/portfolio`.
evidence.failureScenario: If `/portfolio` stops requesting the portfolio endpoint, the KPI component test still passes.

findingList.message: The table contract test does not cover the criterion’s negative case for sensitive values in extra projection properties.

evidence.codePathTraced: `executive_portfolio_table_contract` checks displayed text and row callback behavior using rows without extra projection properties. It does not supply the specified secret values or assert their absence.
evidence.failureScenario: If the table starts rendering `SECRET-ITEM-1`, `SECRET-EVIDENCE`, `SECRET-DRAFT`, or `SECRET-DECISION` from extra properties, this test still passes.

findingList.message: The required `executive_portfolio_row_opens_matching_read_only_summary` App-host test is missing.

evidence.codePathTraced: The changed App tests cover executive portfolio sign-in and Hangar entry, but no test selects `case-002` through the App and asserts the matching read-only summary.
evidence.failureScenario: If selecting `case-002` opens `case-001` or renders no summary, the component-only callback test still passes.

findingList.message: The `role route navigation` test does not cover the executive `/work` behavior required by the criterion.

evidence.codePathTraced: `role route navigation` asserts the executive `/portfolio` route. It does not navigate to `/work` or check the denial text, worklist absence, or decision-control absence there.
evidence.failureScenario: If executive `/work` renders worklist data or omits `This page is not part of your workspace`, the test still passes.

findingList.message: The read-only test does not cover the criterion’s App-level role-matched decision-panel behavior or the absence of all mutating actions.

evidence.codePathTraced: `AC_017_executive_read_only_contract` renders the summary component alone. It does not exercise the App host or verify decision panels appear only for their matching technical and finance roles.
evidence.failureScenario: If App renders a technical or finance decision panel for the wrong role, this component test still passes.

reviewers.summary: No concrete security vulnerability is reachable in the changed code. Portfolio responses are invalidated on session changes and rows are gated by the current session key; server supplied text is rendered as inert React text.
